data_record: No Zenodo, Hugging Face or Figshare record (queries 2026-10-14: Zenodo 'geryon iacuaniello' only unrelated records; HF datasets 'geryon' 0). The data is the git tree at the pin: 28 log sets results/<run set>/logs-<suite>-<A|B>-r<n>/<model>/<suite>/<task>/<attack>/<file>.json, 3,179 logs. Our pin (profile, census, trial, registry) = 905aae02 = current head; tree totals equal the profile's expected_files 3,313 and expected_bytes 30,876,930. Not selected by the profile: 134 blobs (36 run records results/<run set>/<suite>-<cond>-r<n>[-calibration].json, 28 run stdout .log.gz beside the run records, results/logs/*.log.gz x3, results/pairs.json and pairs-fork-v1.2.json (context artefacts), cmcp-pilot/, READMEs, code). No checksums are published beyond git blob SHAs.
harness: Progent's vendored AgentDojo, version 0.1.29 (sunblaze-ucb/progent agentdojo/pyproject.toml), benchmark v1.2 (docs/running-progent.md section 0; run_condition.py --benchmark-version), cloned with 'git clone --depth 1' at HEAD by scripts/setup_env.sh; Progent's HEAD during the runs (2026-08-25..30) was 8a8eb894b9d5 (2026-05-14; next commit 5be7b63 2026-09-24 only adds LICENSE), so the code is very probably 8a8eb894 plus Geryon's two patches (patch_progent_bedrock.py: register Bedrock model ids; patch_progent_prompts.py: JSON-format hint in the policy prompt, applied after runs-strong-policy) - inference, the run records' benchmark_repo_commit (not read) should confirm it. Pipeline: AgentPipeline.from_config(PipelineConfig(llm=<model>, defense=None, system_message=None)) -> AgentDojo default system prompt; OpenAI provider pointed at Bedrock (bedrock-mantle eu-west-1 OpenAI-compatible endpoint); protocol says temperature 0. Attack important_instructions. Defence switch: SECAGENT_SUITE=<suite> (condition B) with Progent run.sh defaults SECAGENT_UPDATE=True, SECAGENT_IGNORE_UPDATE_ERROR=True (automatic mode), policy model gpt-oss-120b except runs-strong-policy(-fixed) (qwen3-235b) and runs-claude-policy (claude-sonnet-5, rejected). Logs written by benchmark_suite_with_injections(force_rerun=True) under OutputLogger; the --per-pair mode added after two runs died calls suite.run_task_with_pipeline directly and so writes no TraceLogger file (scripts/run_condition.py at the pin). Known bugs relevant: Progent agentdojo/README.md note - slack injection_task_5 checker counts a blocked call left in the trace as attack success; Progent authors corrected their own results by hand (https://github.com/sunblaze-ucb/progent/blob/8a8eb894b9d5/agentdojo/README.md); same defect upstream AgentDojo #168 (open) https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/168; #218 utility_from_traces counts proposed calls (open) https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/218; #181 banking injection tasks 0/1/3 subject check dead code (open) https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/181; #161 banking user_task_5 utility checks the old transaction (open) https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/161; #188 slack utility KeyError when post_webpage does not execute (open) https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/188; #214 non-ASCII tool results as \uXXXX (open) https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/214. Progent fork travel suite has 5 injection tasks (upstream 7; injection_task_2 and _6 absent) per docs/running-progent.md and the tree. AgentDojo JSONDecodeError on malformed tool-call arguments ends a whole run (docs/what-went-wrong.md section 5).

discrepancy_leads: Missing log sets: results/README.md describes runs-full-set as 18 runs (A and B, 3 suites, 3 repeats, 349 pairs) but only 14 log sets are released; slack-A-r3, travel-A-r2, travel-A-r3 and travel-B-r3 have run records (.json, .log.gz) and no TraceLogger logs (425 logs absent). run_condition.py at the pin shows the --per-pair mode bypasses benchmark_suite_with_injections and writes no per-task log, a likely cause (inference). Majority-of-3 numbers for slack A and travel A/B cannot be recomputed from the logs alone.

Unusable arms included as ordinary executions: results/README.md marks runs-strong-policy (policy updates failing to parse, 25 calls with no policy) and runs-claude-policy (failed run) as 'NO - must not be quoted'; the profile maps both as normal condition-B Progent executions (198+1 logs) with no caveat.

Defence configuration not in identity: the policy-authoring model (gpt-oss-120b vs qwen3-235b) and the prompt patch state differ between runs/ B, runs-strong-policy and runs-strong-policy-fixed; the identity table records only defence 'progent'.

Code identity is recoverable: profile says the Progent commit is not recorded (code_identity unpinned), but results/README.md says each run record carries benchmark_repo/benchmark_repo_commit (a sunblaze-ucb/progent commit); Progent HEAD during the runs was 8a8eb894b9d5. Also the context artefacts (run_condition.py, patch_progent_prompts.py) at the pin were changed after the runs (bddceabf, 35b97131, 78a2d3d0, 905aae02).

Slack injection_task_5 scoring: Progent's agentdojo/README.md (not the top-level README) [fact-check corrected location] states the checker counts a blocked call still in the trace as attack success and that Progent's authors corrected results by hand (AgentDojo #168); Geryon reports logged values. Condition-B slack logs with security true on injection_task_5 may include denied-only attempts.

Within-policy subset: runs/, runs-strong-agent, runs-strong-policy(-fixed) log 90 attacked pairs per run while every reported rate uses only the 42 pairs of results/pairs.json; an outcome comparison over all 90 would not match the paper numbers.
